description_html:
<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    Prerequisite: ELEG 4202/MCEG 4202.

First of a two part sequence of courses to complete a group project in electrical engineering design. Emphasis will be placed on designing an electrical system or subsystem with due regard for Safety, environmental concerns, reliability, longevity, ease of manufacture, maintainability, and cost effectiveness. A written and oral report are required.
    
</section>
